title: Which language is spoken here? Asia
intro: Each map shows a country and its flag. Tap an official language of that country.

rounds.explain: Arabic is an official language of United Arab Emirates.
Persian is an official language of Afghanistan (so are Pushto).
Armenian is an official language of Armenia.
Azerbaijani is an official language of Azerbaijan.
Bengali is an official language of Bangladesh.
Malay is an official language of Brunei.
Dzongkha is an official language of Bhutan.
Chinese is an official language of China.
Turkish is an official language of Cyprus (so are Modern Greek).
Georgian is an official language of Georgia.
Indonesian is an official language of Indonesia.
Hebrew is an official language of Israel.
Hindi is an official language of India.
Japanese is an official language of Japan.
Kirghiz is an official language of Kyrgyzstan.
Khmer is an official language of Cambodia.
Korean is an official language of North Korea.
Kazakh is an official language of Kazakhstan.
Lao is an official language of Laos.
Sinhala is an official language of Sri Lanka (so are Tamil).
Burmese is an official language of Myanmar.
Mongolian is an official language of Mongolia.
Dhivehi is an official language of Maldives.
Nepali is an official language of Nepal.
Filipino is an official language of Philippines.
Urdu is an official language of Pakistan.
Thai is an official language of Thailand.
Tajik is an official language of Tajikistan.
Tetum is an official language of East Timor.
Turkmen is an official language of Turkmenistan.
Uzbek is an official language of Uzbekistan.
Vietnamese is an official language of Vietnam.
